sanskrit_verse: अदण्ड्यान् दण्डयन् राजा दण्ड्यांश् चैवाप्य् अदण्डयन् । अयशो महद् आप्नोति नरकं चैव गच्छति ॥
transliteration: adaṇḍyān daṇḍayan rājā daṇḍyāṃś caivāpy adaṇḍayan | ayaśo mahad āpnoti narakaṃ caiva gacchati ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The ruler who punishes the innocent and fails to punish the guilty incurs great dishonor and descends into degradation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority must align with Dharma to maintain cosmic order.
Misapplication of justice disrupts societal consciousness.
Capacity-based responsibility requires discernment of guilt and innocence.
Restoration logic demands correction of misapplied authority.
Consciousness alignment depends on just execution of duty.
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler punishes innocent THEN action invalidates authority.
IF ruler exempts guilty THEN justice system failure triggered.
WHEN misapplication detected THEN automatic review by Dharma-compliant tribunal required.
WHEN honor loss observed THEN mandatory restoration protocol initiated.
WHEN degradation risk identified THEN capacity rehabilitation enforced.
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority must ensure that no act of misjudgment—whether omission or commission—is permitted to stand. The threshold of responsibility includes recognition of both factual guilt and procedural integrity. Misuse of power leads to institutional dishonor and necessitates immediate corrective adjudication aligned with SPH-sourced Dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that misapplication of justice produces inevitable consequences in consciousness. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how error compounds through systemic distortion. Proportional responsibility lies with the executor of law. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that consequence arises naturally from violation of Dharma, not through external imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate public acknowledgment of error by ruling authority.
Undertake purification process for contaminated judicial field.
Realign ruler's capacity through supervised dharmic retraining.
Restore societal trust via transparent correction procedures.
Implement preventive oversight protocols to avoid recurrence.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is restored. Justice flows from consciousness, not coercion. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the supreme adjudicator.
